title: Prosthetic Valves or Repaired Valves
instructions: Fill in 'answer' for every field. 'single' fields take exactly one option (a string); 'multi' fields take a list of every option that applies; 'text' fields take a short free-text string. A field with 'only_if' is only answered when its condition holds: each listed field's answer must include one of the listed options (all listed fields must match; for 'only_if_any', at least one entry must match). A field is also skipped when the field it depends on was itself skipped. Use null for skipped fields. Fields marked 'optional' may be left null (or [] for multi) even when shown. 'cannot_evaluate' means the finding cannot be evaluated from the data provided.
